title: Cryptoassets Standard: Consultation on Return Templates (MA(BS)28 Explanatory Notes)
summary: On 13 June 2025, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) published explanatory notes for banking return MA(BS)28, part of a wider consultation titled 'Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates,' per the document's own title. HKMA's numbered 'MA' returns are standardised periodic reports Authorized Institutions file with HKMA for prudential supervision; explanatory notes are the accompanying guidance on completing a given return. HKMA issued a series of similar consultation materials covering multiple MA(BS) forms the same day. HKMA's document repository returned a server error (HTTP 503) on every attempt to retrieve the full page during this review, so the specific proposed changes and the consultation's response deadline are not confirmed against primary source text; this summary reflects only the document's own published title.
why_it_matters: This consultation extends HKMA's routine prudential-reporting requirements for banks to explicitly cover cryptoasset exposures, through one of several linked technical documents rather than a single rulebook. For a newcomer, it is a sign Hong Kong's banking regulator is building cryptoasset-specific reporting into its everyday supervisory machinery, not only its licensing rules.
